about-me.title: ABOUT ME:
about-me.description: Systems Development Technician with an interest in front-end development, currently studying Information Technology Management.
about-me.content: I have a creative profile with a strong interest in communication and technology, combining technical skills with clear information delivery. I have experience in cybersecurity, focusing on information security best practices, digital security awareness, and risk prevention in technological environments. I believe in the integration of technology and communication to develop efficient, secure, and user-centered solutions.
